goal: Add a subtract function to the toy calculator so the calculator covers all four basic operations. Callers need it to compute differences without negating by hand.

applies.text: Code quality is caught before and during writing, not by review loops or CI after the fact.
The same quality rules apply to every author, human or agent, enforced in the build.
Agents are guided by the paved road: the right way is the easy way, and acceptance criteria and rules are handed over upfront.
Work enters in a structured way: decisions first, then slices; nothing free-floating; the backlog is bounded.
Low cost and fast flow: low tokens, low maintenance, no step that slows the whole process.
A self-sustained, reusable plugin that works in any project on day one.
Industry standards and best practices for every choice; no invented processes.
OSS and code reuse before new code. Host first: use what Claude Code, git and GitHub already do.
No agent in the mechanical path. Period. A program runs git, tests, measuring and ordering.
No pass/fail gates on quality. Facts are recorded, limits cap rounds, and only measured targets move work on. Refusals are used only for order.
Every rejection teaches what is wrong, the right way, and how to prevent it, concisely.
Nobody grades themselves.
Paved road over restriction. Keep a restriction only when it is cheap and protects measurement.
No hard-coding. Every limit is a default with an override in a standard place (the plugin's project-local folder).
Convention over configuration: presets, inference, ask once, and answers stored in standard files.
No excess: build only for a measured need; low cost, clear, extensible.
Rules apply forward: ratchets, no retrofit sweeps, no reopening old decision records.
Don't plan around things we can't control (for example CI, or accounts we can't create).
Acceptance tests are visible (ATDD) and written by someone other than the builder.
The packet is written only by the orchestrator or planner, and arrives at session start.
A builder MUST be launched only with an approved work packet as input. That launch order is what puts design before code.

decisions.text: The calculator functions are pure and take two numbers.

acceptance.scenario: subtract returns the difference of its two arguments
the toy asks the owner no question

definition_of_done: Every acceptance item is met by the measurer.
